_comment: THE SHARD'S DROP, IN ITS OWN FILE, so it can carry a condition (#276).
A loot POOL cannot be conditioned and neither, as it turns out, can a TAG - measured: a tag
file's neoforge:conditions is ignored in 26.1 and the tag kept its member without AE2. What
IS honoured is a condition on a whole loot table FILE, so the drop lives in one and
slag_rubble_pulls reaches it through a minecraft:loot_table entry.
Without AE2 this file does not load, the reference resolves to nothing, and the pull yields
nothing - which is the point, because the Sky Stone Shard is useless without AE2 and CLAUDE.md
is explicit that a find which is neither useful nor wanted is clutter.
